jobs.title: Senior Director, Digital Channels, Insurance Tech
jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

Lead strategic innovation and operational excellence across RBC Insurance's digital assets. As Senior Director, Digital Channels, you'll own end-to-end strategy and delivery across our digital ecosystem, from Online Insurance platforms built on RBC's proprietary tech stack to Advisor Portals powered by Salesforce.

In this pivotal role, you'll serve as the central point of accountability for optimizing digital touchpoints that drive customer engagement and advisor productivity. You'll collaborate seamlessly with Technology, Business, Digital & Data, Operations, and Product teams to execute high-impact initiatives that deliver operational excellence and measurable business results.

This is an opportunity to shape how RBC Insurance connects with customers and advisors in the digital age.

What will you do?

Shape the digital vision: Drive the multi-year strategy and roadmap for Online Insurance and Advisor Portal platforms, ensuring every initiative drives organizational priorities forward
Champion client-first digital innovation: Lead a disciplined approach to understanding client needs and translating them into platform capabilities. Drive accountability for user experience metrics and ensure every digital initiative measurably improves client satisfaction and engagement.
Deliver at scale: Lead end-to-end execution of digital channel initiatives across RBC's proprietary tech stack and Salesforce environments, translating strategic vision into executable roadmaps and quarterly milestones
Own financial accountability: Develop, manage, and optimize operational budgets and delivery financial plans to ensure cost-effective, timely execution without compromising quality
Drive accountability through data and transparency: Establish and monitor delivery performance metrics, KPIs, and transparent status reporting that enable informed decision-making
Build lasting partnerships: Serve as the trusted delivery partner to business stakeholders, cultivating strong relationships across Digital Channels, Product, and Business Operations to align priorities and remove obstacles
Translate impact into narrative: Communicate digital platform progress through compelling storytelling that connects technical achievements to measurable business value and customer outcomes
Lead and inspire teams: Provide strategic leadership to developers, engineers, and technical specialists, building a high-performance culture of collaboration. Coach technical leaders on delivery excellence, strategic thinking, and career development
Champion continuous learning: Cultivate a team of technical thought leaders who stay at the forefront of industry trends, emerging technologies, and digital platform best practices, ensuring RBC Insurance maintains competitive advantage and drives innovation across digital channels.

What do you need to succeed?

Must Have

10+ years of progressive leadership in digital delivery, platform engineering, or technology transformation, with 5+ years leading technical teams delivering enterprise-scale IT solutions
Experience leading AI driven innovation across digital channels, including both implementing AI solutions and championing AI driven development.
Skilled in leveraging AI and emerging technologies to enhance platform capabilities, drive innovation, and optimize delivery outcomes
Deep expertise across technology landscapes. Proficient in both legacy and modern tech stacks (RBC ecosystem and Salesforce), with strong understanding of integration, orchestration, and hybrid technology ecosystems
Demonstrated track record delivering complex digital solutions at enterprise scale within financial institutions or regulated industries
Ability to lead diverse teams and influence senior stakeholders through data-driven decision-making, executive communication, and strong facilitation skills
Strong foundation in software development lifecycle, API management, data flows, budgeting, and resource allocation to drive cost-effective delivery

Nice to Have

10+ years of progressive leadership experience in digital delivery, platform engineering, or technology transformation; 5+ years leading technical teams delivering IT solutions
Proven experience delivering complex digital solutions at enterprise scale within financial institutions or regulated industries
Expertise in both legacy and modern tech stacks (RBC technology ecosystem and Salesforce platforms); Deep understanding of integration, orchestration, and hybrid technology
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence senior stakeholders through data-driven decision-making; Superior executive-level communication, presentation, and facilitation skills

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
Ability to make a difference and lasting impact
Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team
A world-class training program in financial services
Opportunities to do challenging work
Opportunities to take on progressively greater accountabilities
Opportunities to build close relationships with clients
Access to a variety of job opportunities across business and geographies.

jobs.title: Vice President, Data Management
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Vice President, Head of Data Management, is primarily responsible for Omnicom’s data architecture, governance, integrity, and movement of data.
This role oversees data architecture, such as cloud-based platforms for storage and analytics, as well as the composer layer that allows for bespoke workflow and data pipelines to be designed/provisioned, and the orchestration layer to automate workflows/tasks that are durable, reliable and scalable. In general, this role focuses on upstream solution design and management (including how data is collected, structured, stored, and made accessible), and works closely with stakeholders in global engineering, local IT, and data solutions teams to maintain data quality, privacy compliance (e.g. PIPEDA, Law 25), and scalability of the data ecosystem.

This role requires a strong familiarity with common media analytics and technology tools, both syndicated and proprietary. The ideal candidate must be able to proactively communicate ideas and opportunities, build strong relationships with internal and external partners, and evolve the data management practice across the Canadian offices. The candidate must have a mindset towards fostering processes through automation, as well as establishing data as the backbone of other OM media disciplines.

Primary Responsibilities

Administrative & Departmental Development

Work with OM Global Central Team, and local Data and Solutions and Business Operations teams to establish agency-level standard Data Management practices and thought leadership. Oversee application of such standards across all OM accounts.
Act as subject matter expert on data operations and business intelligence solutions; prescriptively advise how they should be applied to deliver against client needs.
Contribute to client statements of work (SOWs) and/or service-line agreements (SLAs) during contract negotiations, re-negotiations and renewals
Work with team leadership, finance and data solutions resourcing, both onshore and offshore, to establish resource rate cards, platform and staffing costs and various business engagement requirements
Align resources to accounts based upon client project requirements and/or SOWs. Recruit new employees, as needed.
Serve as the escalation point to address critical business issues; have direct conversations with internal teams and clients, as needed. Support the development of short-term plans to prioritize needs and to resolve urgent issues.
Analyze employee time utilization to ensure employee hours are properly scoped to the right projects

Data Management & Strategy

Collaborate with the Chief Data & Solutions Officier on both overall OM, and individual client, data strategy
Define standards and best practices for data ingestion, data harmonization, data storage and data governance.
Act as the subject matter expert for projects relating to data quality and business rules
Demand best practices are being followed by onshore and offshore data teams across all engagements
Lead and manage cross-functional and cross-organizational teams to understand complex data issues involving multiple systems
Establish priorities, develop improvement plans, allocate resources, and implement solutions
Keep up to date on digital operations - buy changes, creative specifications, etc

Data Governance & Documentation

Lead the development of a comprehensive departmental data management and integrity program, including being accountable on cross-account adoption of a coordinated governance process
Drive cross-discipline documentation process and create standardization for validating the implementation, optimization, and reconciliation of all campaign data
Oversee the documentation of processes, workflows, and technical implementations of any project. Proactively identify, propose, and generate targeted solutions for data quality issues and operational inefficiencies.

People & Project Management

Socialize OM and projects tasks staging/RACIs - ensuring clarity on roles, responsibilities and expectations across teams
Supervise Directors and Managers to perform data management, data operations, data quality assurance and client project tasks. Provide guidance to team members and promote a team environment.
Accountable for growth of direct reports. Tailor OM, client and personal goals to develop and emphasize strengths of each direct report.

Experience, Skill and Technical Requirements

10+ years’ experience in data operations and/or business intelligence, including 8+ years in a management role, 2+ years in a senior management role
8+ years’ experience (media agency, in-house media team or retail media network), working directly with media data (ad server, display & video, search, social, offline, etc)
8+ years’ experience in an agile development environment
Minimum 8 years’ experience in client facing work
Experience managing teams that are onshore and offshore
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Strong organizational and project management skills (scoping, task staging, resource and change management)
Advanced proficiency with one or more of: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Intelligence (fka Datorama), Power BI, Alteryx, Tableau. Experience with Google BigQuery and Cloud Composer 3 a plus.
Intermediate proficiency with Amazon Web Services (S3, Redshift)
3+ years’ experience with project management platforms such as Hive, Asana or Smartsheet
Intermediate proficiency with Excel and PowerPoint

Omnicom Media is providing the compensation range that the company is willing to pay for this position based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills and abilities. In addition, Omnicom Media provides rewarding offerings such as:

• Generous paid time off with a minimum of 37 paid days off including vacation and monthly wellness days. We also have four-day long weekends, half-day summer Fridays, and meeting-free Friday afternoons year-round.
• A flexible hybrid work model that works for you.
• A focus on personal development with formal training opportunities, including mental health training and inclusion education for everyone.
• A chance to be part of and grow within a global network of agencies.
• The opportunity to contribute to our company culture by joining one of our many community-based employee groups, such as Black Employee Network, Girls on Fire, Hispanic or Latinx Alliance, Neuro Network, Pan-Asian Network, and Rainbow Lounge.

Omnicom is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, creed, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship, genetic information, disability, or any other basis prohibited by applicable federal, provincial, or municipal law. jobs.title: AVP, Technology and Transformation Risk
jobs.description:
Experience Aviva

Individually we are people, but together we are Aviva. Individually these are just words, but together they are our Values – Care, Commitment, Community, and Confidence.

At Aviva Canada, we put people first, our employees, our customers, and our communities. We’re proud of a culture built on care, inclusion, and collaboration, where your voice matters and your growth is supported. We’re not just about insurance; we’re about making a real difference by protecting what matters most.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for an AVP, Technology & Transformation Risk to lead second‑line oversight of technology, data privacy, data governance, cybersecurity and transformation across Aviva Canada. In this role, you’ll shape how we manage data risk, strengthen controls, and respond to an evolving regulatory and technology landscape.

You’ll work closely with partners across the business to provide independent challenge, guide decision‑making, and support strong governance practices. You will also play a key role in advancing our approach to emerging areas such as GenAI, automation, and data ethics.

This is a highly visible opportunity to influence strategy, build positive relationships, and help ensure Aviva delivers safe, fair, and trusted outcomes for our customers.

What You’ll Do

Provide second‑line oversight of technology, cyber security practices, data privacy, data governance and transformation risks.
Partner with first‑line teams to identify risks, strengthen controls, and improve data practices.
Lead data risk reviews, deep dives, and assessment activities to ensure regulatory and policy alignment.
Deliver clear, insight‑driven reports that highlight trends, issues, and emerging risks.
Build positive relationships across the business to support consistent and effective risk management.
Champion best practices in cybersecurity, data governance, privacy, GenAI, and automation.
Collaborate with teams to enable safe and efficient automation and AI use cases.
Maintain documentation that supports governance, transparency, and compliance.
Contribute to strong customer outcomes through sound risk oversight.

What You’ll Bring

A degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Business, or a related field.
10+ years of experience in data governance, data management, analytics, or a related discipline.
Strong understanding of Cyber Security including ISO 27001 and NIST framework
Strong understanding of data privacy, data quality, and regulatory expectations.
Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to influence partners at all levels.
Experience assessing risks, reviewing controls, and preparing insight‑driven reports.
Ability to tackle sophisticated problems, make sound decisions, and drive outcomes.
Strong relationship‑building skills and a collaborative working style.
Knowledge of data architecture, data lineage, data quality, data retention and emerging data practices.
Good understanding of Secure by Design principles
Curiosity and adaptability to keep pace with evolving technologies, including AI and automation.

What Makes You Stand Out

Experience working with GenAI, automation, and AI governance.
Familiarity with operational risk practices.
Strong visual communication and storytelling skills.
Ability to effectively challenge senior leaders with confidence and clarity.
Deep understanding of cyber, data, and IT infrastructure domains.

What You’ll Get

Compelling rewards package including base compensation, eligibility for annual bonus, retirement savings, share plan, health benefits, personal wellness, and volunteer opportunities.
Hybrid flexible work model.
Outstanding career development opportunities.
We’ll support your professional development education.
Competitive vacation package with the option to purchase 5 extra days off per year.
Employee-driven programs focused on gender, LGBTQ+, origins, diversity, and inclusion.
Corporate wellness programs to support our employees’ physical and mental health.

jobs.title: Vice President Finance
jobs.description:
Based in Burlington, Ontario, our client is a growing, market-leading North American manufacturer of welded aluminum and brass tubing for heat transfer applications across diverse industrial sectors. With a strong reputation for quality, reliability, and technical expertise, our client serves customers worldwide and provides dependable solutions for demanding, mission-critical applications.

We are seeking a hands-on and strategic Vice President, Finance to join its executive leadership team. This individual will oversee the organization’s financial strategy, planning, reporting, accounting, treasury, and risk management functions while providing clear financial insight to support sustainable growth and operational performance. The successful candidate will be a trusted business partner who is comfortable working across the organization and contributing to decisions that extend beyond traditional finance.

Responsibilities

Provide leadership for all financial operations, including financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, treasury management, and long-range strategic planning.
Prepare and oversee timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
Partner with ownership and executive leadership to develop and execute financial strategies that support profitability, operational excellence, and sustainable growth.
Deliver meaningful financial analysis, variance reporting, and key performance indicators to support informed decision-making across the organization.
Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, and strategic planning processes while monitoring financial performance against established objectives.
Oversee treasury functions, including cash flow management, working capital optimization, liquidity planning, foreign exchange exposure, and capital allocation.
Manage customs and duty-related activities, including U.S. duty reconciliations, customs compliance requirements, and annual customs bond renewals.
Lead the annual external audit process and manage relationships with auditors, financial institutions, legal advisors, tax authorities, and insurance providers.
Ensure compliance with all applicable tax, regulatory, insurance, and corporate governance requirements.
Oversee accounts receivable collections, accounts payable, payroll support, and day-to-day accounting operations.
Provide leadership and support to Human Resources, Reception, and Accounts Payable functions while contributing to broader administrative and office management activities.
Serve as the organization's ERP subject matter expert, supporting system optimization and cross-functional business processes.
Review contracts and provide financial and commercial input to support business decisions across all departments.
Participate as a key member of the leadership team by contributing to executive, ownership, operational, quality, and management review meetings.
Support information technology, telecommunications, and other operational initiatives through coordination with external service providers.
Perform additional duties as assigned while promoting a safe, organized, and compliant workplace.

Skills & Qualifications

CPA designation in good standing required.
Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, or a related discipline
10+ years of progressive finance and accounting experience, including senior leadership responsibility.
Proven experience in a manufacturing environment.
Strong knowledge of financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning and analysis (FP&A).
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute financial strategies that support growth, profitability, and long-term business objectives.
Experience leading annual audits and managing relationships with auditors, financial institutions, legal counsel, insurance providers, and regulatory authorities.
Strong treasury management experience, including cash flow forecasting, working capital management, foreign exchange, and banking relationships.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, with strong overall proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite.
Strong business acumen with the ability to translate complex financial information into clear, actionable recommendations.
Excellent leadership, communication, and relationship management skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
Ability to travel occasionally

Benefits

Competitive compensation package, including a base salary of $225,000 to $275,000 and participation in the management incentive plan.
Comprehensive Company-sponsored health benefits & retirement savings program
Potential participation in a Management Incentive Plan
A highly visible leadership role with broad organizational impact
The opportunity to combine strategic leadership with hands-on involvement in a dynamic manufacturing environment
A collaborative, entrepreneurial culture where ideas are valued and contributions are recognized

jobs.title: Director, Business Intelligence and Advanced Analytics
Interim Vice President, Finance, Technology & Business Operations
jobs.description:
IMMEDIATE INTERIM OPPORTUNITY

Interim Vice President, Finance, Technology & Business Operations

Reports To: Chief Executive Officer

Duration: 3 to 6 months

Location: Greater Toronto Area

Hybrid Working

Our client is a respected national not-for-profit organization with a complex operating model, multiple stakeholders and a strong mission-driven culture. The organization works collaboratively with regional partners and relies on effective financial stewardship, technology, data, risk management and business operations to deliver on its mandate.

The Opportunity

The organization is seeking an experienced interim executive to provide transitional leadership following an unexpected leave. This is a three-to-six-month assignment combining hands-on operational oversight with strategic advice and support to the CEO.

The Interim Vice President will inherit a capable, well-performing team across finance and technology. The priority is not to initiate unnecessary change, but to provide stability, sound judgment and thoughtful leadership through a delicate period of transition. The successful interim will maintain operational continuity, coach and support the team, and ensure that the CEO and executive leadership have the financial information, analytics and technology advice required for effective decision-making.

The portfolio includes responsibility for finance and technology/information services, with broader involvement in business operations, risk and organizational planning.

Transitional and Operational Leadership

Provide steady, visible and reassuring leadership during a sensitive period of transition.
Assume day-to-day executive accountability for finance, technology and related business operations.
Maintain momentum on existing priorities while ensuring continuity of critical services, reporting and controls.
Quickly assess emerging issues and determine which matters require immediate attention, which should continue as planned and which should be deferred.
Establish an effective working relationship with the CEO and serve as a trusted, pragmatic strategic adviser.
Support clear communication and collaboration across the executive team and broader organization.

Finance, Analytics and Executive Decision Support

Oversee budgeting, forecasting, cash management, financial reporting, audit readiness and core financial operations.
Ensure the continued integrity of financial systems, internal controls and risk-management practices.
Provide the CEO, executive team and Board committees with timely, relevant and decision-oriented financial analysis.
Strengthen the quality of management information by moving reporting beyond historical results toward clearer analysis of trends, risks, opportunities and forward-looking implications.
Improve the use of data, dashboards and analytics to support program, operational and resource-allocation decisions.
Ensure leaders receive appropriate support in developing and monitoring departmental and program budgets.
Maintain oversight of funder reporting, donor and partnership funds, charitable reporting requirements and other sector-specific financial obligations.

The underlying role is responsible for budgeting, financial analysis, monthly reporting, accounts payable and receivable, payroll, cash management, donor receipting, audit coordination and charitable-sector reporting.

Technology, AI and Cybersecurity

Provide executive oversight of the technology function and ensure that systems and services remain reliable, secure and aligned with organizational priorities.
Review the organization’s technology roadmap and identify immediate risks, dependencies and opportunities.
Help the CEO and executive team evaluate the responsible use of artificial intelligence, including where AI can improve productivity, analysis and service delivery while appropriately managing privacy, security and reputational risk.
Assess the organization’s cybersecurity and data-privacy posture, ensuring that material vulnerabilities and required actions are clearly understood by leadership.
Support the organization in prioritizing technology investments based on operational value, risk and available resources.
Ensure major technology initiatives are appropriately governed and positioned to deliver reliable performance and a positive user experience.
Strengthen the connection between finance, technology and organizational data so that leadership receives more integrated and actionable insights.

Team Leadership and Coaching

Lead a small, established team across finance and technology with empathy, clarity and consistency.
Preserve the strengths of a well-performing team while providing the direction and executive access needed during the transition.
Coach team members, clarify priorities and reinforce accountability without creating disruption or unnecessary organizational change.
Identify opportunities to strengthen capability, cross-functional collaboration and succession coverage.
Create an environment in which team members feel supported, informed and confident in raising concerns or escalating risks.
Provide the CEO with an objective assessment of team capacity, operating pressures and longer-term organizational needs.

Risk, Governance and Business Operations

Maintain effective financial, technology, privacy, legal and operational risk-management practices.
Ensure that material risks are identified, evaluated, documented and communicated to the CEO and the appropriate Board committee.
Support risk-register updates, insurance considerations, crisis-management readiness and business-continuity planning.
Ensure contracts and material commitments receive appropriate financial, operational and legal review.
Contribute to operational planning and help align organizational priorities, resources and budgets.
Prepare clear transition documentation and recommendations to support the eventual return or onboarding of permanent leadership.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The successful candidate will be an accomplished finance and business operations executive who has previously led both finance and technology portfolios. They will bring the maturity and judgment required to enter a stable team, establish credibility quickly and lead through a sensitive transition without overstepping the interim mandate.

Ideally, the candidate will offer:

Senior executive experience as a CFO, Vice President of Finance, Vice President of Corporate Services, or Vice President of Finance and Operations.
Demonstrated responsibility for both finance and information technology, either through direct leadership or an integrated corporate-services portfolio.
Experience working in a not-for-profit, charitable, membership-based, sport, healthcare, education or similar mission-driven environment.
Strong financial leadership capabilities encompassing budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, audit, internal controls, cash management and executive decision support.
Experience improving management reporting, data analytics, business intelligence and organizational performance insights.
Meaningful exposure to cybersecurity, data privacy, technology governance and digital transformation.
A practical understanding of artificial intelligence and the governance considerations associated with its responsible organizational use.
Experience advising a CEO and presenting complex financial, operational and technology matters to executive teams and Board committees.
A collaborative, low-ego leadership style and demonstrated success coaching capable teams through periods of uncertainty or transition.
Discretion, diplomacy and emotional steadiness are required for a confidential leadership assignment.
A professional accounting designation would be strongly preferred.
Bilingualism would be considered an asset.

Leadership Style

This assignment will suit an interim executive who is:

Calm grounded and comfortable operating in ambiguity.
Strategic while remaining willing to engage directly in operational matters.
Respectful of the organization’s culture, history and existing team.
Able to distinguish between urgent stabilization needs and longer-term transformation opportunities.
Skilled at translating financial and technology complexity into clear executive-level advice.
Comfortable challenging constructively while remaining supportive of the CEO and leadership team.
Focused on leaving the organization, its systems and its people stronger at the conclusion of the mandate.

Measures of Success

Success over the three-to-six-month assignment will include:

Uninterrupted delivery of critical finance, technology and business operations.
A supported, engaged and well-directed finance and technology team.
Reliable financial reporting, forecasting, controls and audit readiness.
More decision-useful data, analytics and insights for the CEO and executive team.
Clearer prioritization of technology, AI, cybersecurity and data-privacy risks.
Sound and timely strategic advice to the CEO.
Effective management and escalation of organizational risks.
A disciplined transition plan, including documentation of key decisions, open issues and recommendations for longer-term leadership.

jobs.title: Managing Director, Media Strategy
jobs.description:
Position Description

ROLE:
MANAGING DIRECTOR , MEDIA STRATEGY(Financial Institution Experience)

TEAM:
ACCOUNTS, SALT MEDIA

LOCATION
: TORONTO (HYBRID)

Company Overview

Salt is a North American marketing agency that creates connected experiences through creative, digital & media innovation. Our mission is to “Earn The World’s Attention” and Salt is built to find, develop, execute, and amplify the ideas that are worthy of our clients’ audiences. We’ve structured our agency to do what’s right for our clients – to connect different perspectives, to work across mediums, and to focus on delivering meaningful, effective results.

We’re committed to living up to the values in our name. “Salt of The Earth” means we value collaborative, humble, hard-working people here. We’re looking for people who are as smart as they are kind because we believe the right talent and the right culture help us do what’s right for our clients.

Role Overview

As a Managing Director, Media, you will lead Salt’s media practice by driving strategic excellence, operational performance, and commercial growth across a portfolio of clients and media investments. You are responsible for shaping media strategy, guiding investment decisions, and ensuring best-in-class planning, buying, measurement, and optimization across all channels.

You oversee multidisciplinary teams, foster senior client relationships, and champion innovation in media technology, audience strategy, and performance marketing. As a senior agency leader, you balance long-term vision with hands-on leadership—stepping in to solve complex business challenges, elevate client outcomes, and create scalable systems that drive growth.

This role is about building a high-performing media practice that delivers measurable business impact. You will be accountable for portfolio performance, media investment stewardship, team development, operational excellence, and expanding Salt’s media capabilities in a rapidly evolving landscape

Core Responsibilities

Media Strategy & Planning Leadership

Lead integrated, full-funnel media strategies across a portfolio of clients, ensuring alignment with business objectives, customer journeys, and brand goals.
Establish strategic planning frameworks and media approaches that drive consistency, innovation, and measurable outcomes across teams.
Guide senior media leaders in developing channel strategies, investment allocations, and audience approaches that maximize effectiveness and efficiency.
Partner with Strategy, Creative, Digital, and Account teams to deliver connected marketing solutions that drive business growth.
Represent Salt as a media thought leader through client presentations, industry events, and marketplace engagement.

Media Buying & Investment Management

Oversee media investment across client portfolios, ensuring budgets are optimized to deliver maximum performance and value.
Lead media investment philosophy, governance, and buying practices across all channels and platforms.
Build and maintain executive-level relationships with media partners, publishers, and technology vendors to unlock innovation, preferential pricing, and strategic opportunities.
Negotiate high-value media agreements and partnerships that improve agency leverage and client outcomes.
Ensure media plans and investments remain aligned to business objectives, market conditions, and evolving consumer behaviors.

Measurement, Analytics & Insight Development

Champion data-driven decision-making across the media practice through robust measurement frameworks and reporting standards.
Oversee dashboard strategy, data integration, and performance reporting processes that provide actionable insights to clients and teams.
Guide teams in translating media performance data into strategic recommendations that improve future planning and business results.
Ensure consistent measurement methodologies are applied across client portfolios to support optimization, accountability, and learning.
Promote a culture of testing, learning, and continuous improvement through data and analytics.

Media Technology & Innovation

Lead the adoption and evolution of media tools, platforms, and technologies that improve operational efficiency and campaign effectiveness.
Oversee vendor relationships and platform partnerships to ensure optimal utilization, innovation, and return on investment.
Identify emerging technologies, automation opportunities, and industry trends that can strengthen Salt’s media capabilities.
Collaborate with leadership to establish long-term technology roadmaps that support agency growth and competitive advantage.
Drive innovation initiatives that improve workflow efficiency, scalability, and campaign performance.

Performance Optimization & Audience Strategy

Champion advanced optimization frameworks, automation solutions, and testing methodologies across client portfolios.
Guide teams in developing audience-first strategies that leverage data, segmentation, and behavioral insights to improve effectiveness.
Establish best practices for audience targeting, channel selection, and performance measurement across all media programs.
Lead innovation in automation, optimization, and performance systems that improve efficiency and business outcomes.

With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. OpenTable is seeking a strategic and operationally-minded Director of FP&A to lead financial planning, forecasting, and analysis for our core operational investments. Located in our Toronto office, this role will have primary ownership over the company’s Operating Expenses (OpEx), Capital Expenditures (CapEx), and Commissions modeling and structures. Management Reporting: Deliver clear monthly and quarterly financial review packages focusing on spend efficiency, capital deployment, and incentive plan effectiveness for senior leadership.

jobs.title: Global Treasury and Finance Audit, AVP
jobs.description:
Corporate Audit is looking for an experienced Assistant Vice President (AVP) to lead and execute complex audits and validation work across Global Treasury. The role will primarily cover liquidity risk, interest rate risk in the banking book, investment portfolio, governance, and related regulatory reporting.

The successful candidate will combine strong audit execution and leadership skills with practical knowledge of Treasury risk management. The individual will lead assigned audit teams through planning, testing, issue development, and reporting. They will also review work for quality and evidentiary support and communicate conclusions to senior management.

The role is for an experienced auditor who must be able to thrive in a fast-paced environment, communicate clearly, and already possess strong auditing capabilities.

Why this role is important to us

The audit team plays an important role in the overall success of the organization. Across the globe, the firm, relies on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability; regulators rely upon us to provide assurance that the bank operates in a manner that is compliant with key banking regulations to properly manage risks to the company and the global financial systems.

What You Will Be Responsible For

As Global Treasury Audit, AVP you will

Lead complex audits across Global Treasury, from planning, through testing, issue development, and final reporting.
Direct audit teams assigned to individual engagements, establish clear expectations, monitor delivery, review workpapers, and coach team members throughout the engagement.
Plan and perform controls testing, including walkthroughs, sample selection, inspection of evidence, reperformance and evaluation of operating effectiveness.
Evaluate Treasury processes against applicable regulatory requirements, supervisory guidance, internal policies, and established risk limits.
Apply professional skepticism to assess the quality, completeness and reliability of evidence, and challenge unsupported or inconsistent explanations.
Use data analytics to support testing, identify anomalies and enable continuous monitoring where appropriate.
Communicate testing status, emerging concerns, scope changes and delivery risks promptly to audit management, together with fact-based analysis and proposed solutions.
Build constructive relationships across the lines of defense while maintaining audit independence and objectivity.
Maintain current knowledge of Global Treasury risks, regulatory expectations and industry practices, particularly in liquidity risk, asset-liability management and interest rate risk.

What We Value

These skills will help you succeed in this role

Practical knowledge of Treasury risk management, with experience in liquidity risk, interest rate risk in the banking book, asset and liability management, or a related discipline.
Strong analytical and professional judgment, including the ability to identify the risks that matter and develop well-supported conclusions.
Ability to independently manage multiple priorities, meet commitments and escalate obstacles early in a fast-paced environment.
Clear, factual and concise written and verbal communication, including communication with senior management and regulators.
Ability to research, interpret and apply regulatory requirements and supervisory expectations relevant to Treasury and liquidity requirements and supervisory guidance.
Collaborative approach and ability to provide clear direction and review feedback to audit team members.

Education And Required Qualifications

The following are required:

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Risk Management or a related field.
At least 5 years of relevant experience in internal audit, Global Treasury, public accounting, or another first- or second-line risk management role.
Experience leading significant workstreams and audit engagements.
Advanced degree or certification, Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), or Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) designation or its equivalent preferred.

Salary Range

$80,000 - $140,000 Annual

This position is responsible for financial reporting, payroll, tax compliance, cash management, and team leadership, while working closely with external advisors to support ongoing operations and strategic initiatives.

Responsibilities

Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting across multiple entities.
Prepare and review quarterly financial statements and support year‑end accounting processes.
Maintain general ledger integrity, intercompany balances, and corporate records.
Manage corporate tax filings including T2s, T3s, T5s, and partnership returns, as well as quarterly tax installments.
Oversee HST, EHT, WSIB reporting and annual reconciliations.
Act as the primary point of contact for CRA correspondence, audits, and notices of assessment.
Oversee bi‑monthly payroll processing, including T4s, ROEs, employee remittances, and garnishments.
Manage employee onboarding and offboarding, payroll changes, benefits administration, and employee records.
Approve online payments, electronic workflows, and daily cheque runs.
Manage banking relationships, financing renewals, lender reporting, and cash management activities.
Track and administer GICs, mortgages, and other financing instruments.
Lead and delegate work across the accounting team, including daily prioritization and workload planning.
Maintain an accurate organizational chart and support team development initiatives.
Manage accounting systems and tools, including Yardi and related subscriptions.
Liaise with external partners including accountants, lawyers, auditors, banks, and property development partners.
Provide financial analysis, reporting, and ad hoc insights to ownership as required.

Skills & Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
CPA designation required.
Minimum five (5) years of progressive accounting or finance experience; real estate or multi‑entity experience is an asset.
Strong knowledge of financial reporting, payroll, and corporate tax compliance.
Experience managing multiple deadlines and working with external advisors.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office; experience with Yardi or similar systems is an asset.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to work independently in an owner‑led environment.

Benefits

Competitive base salary.
Paid time off.
Extended health, dental, and vision coverage.
Life insurance.
On‑site parking.
